name: switch1
notes: Starter profile for the original Nintendo Switch. Screens are recognised by text that the Switch 1 menus share with the Switch 2 (HOME clock, System Settings, Controllers, the button test, stick calibration, No Signal). No menu routes yet: they move the cursor, so they are only added once learned on a real Switch 1 (see profiles/switch2.json for the format). A custom copy in ~/.ns2bench/profiles/switch1.json takes priority.

any: The symbols for any buttons you press
